name: vibe-ui-oss
description: Open-source desktop client for local Mistral Vibe (stdio app-server)

scripts.start: npm run build:ui && npm run ensure:app && echo "Launching Vibe UI OSS…" && VIBE_UI_CDP_PORT=9333 ".runtime/Vibe UI OSS.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron" --remote-debugging-port=9333 .
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:ui && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build:ui && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.mjs --ui
